text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Card Dispute Procedure (Rev 5), the agent completes Form HCU-DSP-114 (Card Transaction Dispute) during the initial contact with the member — whether that contact is by phone, in branch, or via secure message — as part of the dispute intake process, before routing the case to the Card Services dispute queue.","cited_chunk_ids":["card_dispute_procedure::layout::B_structure::0001"],"reason":"The procedure states the form is completed during the initial contact for every dispute."}
